records.jp: ……ここまで来たけど見つからず、か
records.en_original: Still no sign of her this far in...
records.en_auxiliary: Still no sign of her this far in...
records.en: ...We've come this far and still haven't found her.

records.jp: 勇希の記憶は見られるのにね……
records.en_original: But we're still able to see her memories...
records.en_auxiliary: But we're still able to see her memories...
records.en: But we're still able to see her memories...

records.jp: 私、いつもあの子を追いかけてるな
records.en_original: I'm always chasing after her...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm always chasing after her...
records.en: I'm always chasing after her...

records.jp: あの時もそうだった。<CR>突然いなくなった勇希をおいかけて、探し回った
records.en_original: It was the same back then. She vanished suddenly, and I searched everywhere for her.
records.en_auxiliary: It was the same back then. She vanished suddenly, and I searched everywhere for her.
records.en: It was the same then.<CR>Yuki suddenly disappeared, and I ran everywhere looking for her.

records.jp: 伶那さん……
records.en_original: Rena...
records.en_auxiliary: Rena...
records.en: Rena-san...

records.jp: でも、勇希には会えなくて。それで――
records.en_original: But I never found her. And then—
records.en_auxiliary: But I never found her. And then—
records.en: But I couldn't find Yuki. And then—

records.jp: ねえ、看護師さん。あたしが次の施設に行く前に、<CR>一つお願い聞いてくれる？
records.en_original: Um... Nurse? Could I ask you a favor before I move facilities?
records.en_auxiliary: Um... Nurse? Could I ask you a favor before I move facilities?
records.en: Hey, Nurse. Before I leave for the next facility,<CR>could you do me one favor?

records.jp: もちろん。何でも言って？
records.en_original: Of course. Anything!
records.en_auxiliary: Of course. Anything!
records.en: Of course. Ask me anything.

records.jp: ……この病院に、伶那が来るかもしれない
records.en_original: ...I think that Rena might come here looking for me.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I think that Rena might come here looking for me.
records.en: ...Rena might come to this hospital.

records.jp: いつも言ってたあの子？
records.en_original: That girl you always talk about?
records.en_auxiliary: That girl you always talk about?
records.en: The girl you always talk about?

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: もし伶那がここに来たら、伝えてほしいんだ
records.en_original: If she does come here, I want you to tell her something for me.
records.en_auxiliary: If she does come here, I want you to tell her something for me.
records.en: If Rena comes here, I want you to give her a message.

records.jp: あたしのことは、忘れて。<CR>伶那のことを好きになってくれる人は、きっといるって
records.en_original: Tell her..."Please forget about me. I know there's someone out there who will love you, Rena."
records.en_auxiliary: Tell her..."Please forget about me. I know there's someone out there who will love you, Rena."
records.en: 'Forget about me.<CR>I'm sure someone will come along who loves you, Rena.'

records.jp: 勇希ちゃん……本当に、それでいいの？
records.en_original: Yuki... Are you sure?
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki... Are you sure?
records.en: Yuki-chan... Are you really sure?

records.jp: いいんだよ。<CR>これが一番、幸せになれる方法なんだから――
records.en_original: Yeah. This is her best chance at happiness.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. This is her best chance at happiness.
records.en: It's okay.<CR>This is the best way for her to be happy—

records.jp: 勇希、だよね…………？
records.en_original: Yuki! It's you, isn't it...?
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki! It's you, isn't it...?
records.en: Yuki... is that you...?

records.jp: …………来ないで
records.en_original: ...Don't come any closer.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Don't come any closer.
records.en: ...Stay away.

records.jp: 勇希……？
records.en_original: Yuki...?
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki...?
records.en: Yuki...?

records.jp: 来ないで。これ以上進んだら……<CR>全部わかってしまう――
records.en_original: Don't come any closer... If you do...I'll remember...
records.en_auxiliary: Don't come any closer... If you do...I'll remember...
records.en: Stay away. If you come any farther...<CR>you'll find out everything—

records.jp: 勇希っ！！
records.en_original: Yuki!!!
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki!!!
records.en: Yuki!!!

records.jp: また消えちゃった……
records.en_original: She disappeared again...
records.en_auxiliary: She disappeared again...
records.en: She disappeared again...

records.jp: 何か言おうとしていた……？<CR>これ以上進んだらって、何……？
records.en_original: What was she talking about? What does she mean if we come any closer...?
records.en_auxiliary: What was she talking about? What does she mean if we come any closer...?
records.en: Was she trying to say something...?<CR>What did she mean by 'if we go any farther'...?

records.jp: （詩さんの時みたいに、<CR>世界が不安定になってる気配はないけど……）
records.en_original: (This isn't like how things were with Uta, the world is still stable...)
records.en_auxiliary: (This isn't like how things were with Uta, the world is still stable...)
records.en: (Unlike with Uta-san,<CR>the world doesn't seem to be growing unstable, but...)

records.jp: どういうこと、勇希…………？
records.en_original: What could she mean...?
records.en_auxiliary: What could she mean...?
records.en: What do you mean, Yuki...?

records.jp: あ、愛央。宮内さん。どうする？<CR>来ないでって、言われちゃったけど……
records.en_original: Ao. Rena. What do you think we should do? She told us to not go any further...
records.en_auxiliary: Ao. Rena. What do you think we should do? She told us to not go any further...
records.en: A-Ao, Miyauchi-san. What should we do?<CR>She told us to stay away...

records.jp: ……来るなと言われて、<CR>「はいそうですか」って引き返せるわけない
records.en_original: We can't just turn around because she told us to.
records.en_auxiliary: We can't just turn around because she told us to.
records.en: She told us not to come,<CR>but we can't just say, 'Oh, okay,' and turn back.

records.jp: ……うん。でも、<CR>また詩さんの時みたいなことになるかもしれない
records.en_original: ...Yeah. But I can't help but worry that this will turn out like how it was with Uta.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yeah. But I can't help but worry that this will turn out like how it was with Uta.
records.en: ...Yeah. But<CR>this could turn out like it did with Uta-san again.

records.jp: それだけは避けないといけない。<CR>警戒して進もう
records.en_original: We have to avoid that by any means necessary. Let's be careful.
records.en_auxiliary: We have to avoid that by any means necessary. Let's be careful.
records.en: We have to avoid that.<CR>Let's proceed carefully.
